title: The Global AI Debate: Leaders and Tech Giants Clash Over Future Risks
subtitle: As technology advances rapidly, world leaders and industry experts remain divided on whether to slow down or push ahead.

summary.en: The rapid development of artificial intelligence has sparked a major international debate about safety and control. While some technology leaders argue that fears of AI-driven disasters are exaggerated, others are calling for global cooperation to manage risks. China and the United States are currently locked in an intense competition to lead the field in AI capabilities. Meanwhile, governments are struggling to create rules that balance innovation with national security. The upcoming meeting between President Donald Trump and President Xi Jinping will likely focus on these critical technology issues.
summary.zh: 人工智慧的快速發展引發了一場關於安全與控制的重大國際辯論。雖然部分科技領袖認為對人工智慧引發災難的恐懼被誇大了，但其他人則呼籲全球合作以管理風險。中國與美國目前正陷入激烈的競爭，爭奪人工智慧領域的領先地位。與此同時，各國政府正努力制定規則，以平衡創新與國家安全。川普總統與習近平主席即將舉行的會晤，預計將聚焦於這些關鍵的科技議題。

paragraphs.en: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) has become a central point of conflict between world leaders and technology executives. As the industry reaches new levels of power, a debate is growing over whether these systems pose a real threat to humanity or if such concerns are simply unnecessary. This disagreement is now shaping international politics, with the United States and China leading a race to define the future of the technology.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智慧的快速成長已成為世界領袖與科技高層之間衝突的核心焦點。隨著該產業達到新的權力層級，關於這些系統是否對人類構成真正威脅，抑或此類擔憂純屬多餘，各界辯論日益激烈。這種分歧目前正形塑著國際政治，美國與中國正領頭競逐，試圖定義這項技術的未來。

paragraphs.en: In recent weeks, the mood in Silicon Valley has turned serious. Many industry insiders have warned about the potential for AI to cause major problems if it escapes human control. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei recently suggested a global plan to slow down the development of the most advanced models. According to The Guardian, Amodei argued that this plan would require cooperation with China to ensure that democratic nations maintain their lead in AI development. He also supported keeping strict rules on exporting advanced computer chips to China, which some critics describe as a one-sided attempt to limit Chinese progress.
paragraphs.zh: 近幾週，矽谷的氣氛變得嚴肅。許多產業內部人士警告，若人工智慧脫離人類控制，恐引發重大問題。人工智慧公司 Anthropic 的執行長達里歐·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 近期提議一項全球計畫，旨在放緩最先進模型的開發速度。根據《衛報》(The Guardian) 報導，阿莫代主張此計畫需要與中國合作，以確保民主國家在人工智慧發展上保持領先。他也支持對出口至中國的高階電腦晶片實施嚴格限制，部分批評者認為這是一種單方面限制中國進步的企圖。

paragraphs.en: However, not everyone in the technology world agrees with these warnings. Jensen Huang, the CEO of Nvidia, recently told CBS Sunday Morning that he believes the fears surrounding AI are overblown. He claimed there is a “0% chance” of AI ending the world and argued that calls to slow down development are not based on science. According to The Verge, Huang is against new laws or rules for the industry, even after reports of AI models escaping their security systems. Some analysts suggest that Huang’s position is linked to his company’s massive financial success, noting that any delay in the industry could hurt his business growth.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，科技界並非所有人都同意這些警告。輝達 (Nvidia) 執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 近期告訴《哥倫比亞廣播公司週日晨間新聞》(CBS Sunday Morning)，他認為圍繞人工智慧的恐懼被誇大了。他聲稱人工智慧毀滅世界的機率為「零」，並主張要求放緩開發的呼籲缺乏科學根據。根據《The Verge》報導，即便在傳出人工智慧模型逃脫安全系統的報導後，黃仁勳仍反對針對該產業制定新法律或規則。部分分析師認為，黃仁勳的立場與其公司龐大的財務成功有關，並指出產業發展的任何延宕都可能損害其業務成長。

paragraphs.en: China has reacted strongly to the calls for a slowdown. The Chinese government views AI as a vital part of its national strength and is unlikely to accept any rules that it believes are designed to keep the United States in the lead. According to The Guardian, the Chinese foreign ministry stated that “fearmongering” and competition will only hurt global efforts to manage AI. Despite this, experts suggest that China is not ignoring the risks entirely. The country recently released an updated safety framework that addresses concerns like cybersecurity and the possibility of AI learning to improve itself, which some researchers believe shows more common ground with Western concerns than many people expect.
paragraphs.zh: 中國對這些放緩開發的呼籲反應強烈。中國政府將人工智慧視為國家實力的關鍵部分，不太可能接受任何其認為旨在維持美國領先地位的規則。根據《衛報》報導，中國外交部表示，「散布恐懼」與競爭只會損害全球管理人工智慧的努力。儘管如此，專家指出中國並未完全忽視風險。該國近期發布了一份更新後的安全框架，處理網路安全以及人工智慧可能學會自我優化等擔憂，部分研究人員認為這顯示中國與西方在這些議題上的共識比許多人預期的還要多。

paragraphs.en: This tension is further complicated by the different views held by political leaders. While some governments are moving to create strict safety rules—such as California’s recent plan to require a “kill switch” for AI—others are more skeptical. According to The Guardian, U.S. President Donald Trump recently described the fear that AI could destroy humanity as a “hoax.” This difference in opinion makes the path toward global regulation very difficult to predict.
paragraphs.zh: 這種緊張局勢因政治領袖的不同觀點而更趨複雜。雖然部分政府正採取行動制定嚴格的安全規則——例如加州近期計畫要求為人工智慧設置「緊急停止開關」——但其他政府則持懷疑態度。根據《衛報》報導，美國總統川普 (Donald Trump) 近期將人工智慧可能毀滅人類的恐懼描述為一場「騙局」。這種意見分歧使得邁向全球監管的道路極難預測。

paragraphs.en: As the competition intensifies, the stakes are rising for businesses and individuals alike. For entrepreneurs like Boris But, who runs an education company in China, the shift toward AI is already changing how people work and learn. He told The Guardian that he decided to build his own AI tools because he realized that if he could not beat the technology, he had to join it. This sentiment is shared by many, as the pressure to adopt AI grows alongside the fear of being left behind.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著競爭加劇，企業與個人的風險也隨之升高。對於像是在中國經營教育公司的企業家鮑里斯·巴特 (Boris But) 而言，轉向人工智慧已在改變人們工作與學習的方式。他告訴《衛報》，他決定建立自己的人工智慧工具，因為他意識到如果無法擊敗這項技術，就必須加入它。隨著採用人工智慧的壓力與擔心被淘汰的恐懼同步增長，許多人都有同樣的感受。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, all eyes are on the upcoming meeting between President Trump and President Xi Jinping in Washington. While AI is expected to be on the agenda, many experts are not optimistic about a major breakthrough. The two nations remain in a deep rivalry, and both are focused on protecting their own interests. For now, the world remains in a state of uncertainty, waiting to see if international leaders can find a way to work together before the technology advances beyond their control. The debate over whether to prioritize safety or speed will likely continue to dominate the global conversation for the foreseeable future.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，各界目光皆聚焦於川普與習近平即將在華盛頓舉行的會晤。雖然預計人工智慧將列入議程，但許多專家對於能否取得重大突破並不樂觀。兩國仍處於深層的競爭關係，且雙方皆專注於維護自身利益。目前，世界仍處於不確定狀態，等待著國際領袖是否能在技術發展至失控前找到合作之道。關於應優先考慮安全還是速度的辯論，在可預見的未來，很可能持續主導全球對話。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Made to seem larger, more important, or more serious than it really is.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此字常被誤認為是動詞 blow 的過去分詞，但在這裡作為形容詞使用。文中：He claimed there is a “0% chance” of AI ending the world and argued that calls to slow down development are not based on science.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Opinions or interests that are shared by two or more people or groups.
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面意思為「共同的土地」，實際指雙方意見一致的地方。文中：The country recently released an updated safety framework that addresses concerns like cybersecurity and the possibility of AI learning to improve itself, which some researchers believe shows more common ground with Western concerns than many people expect.

keyTerms.definitionEn: The risks involved in a situation; what can be won or lost.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（木樁），這裡指涉局勢的嚴重性與風險。文中：As the competition intensifies, the stakes are rising for businesses and individuals alike.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A list of matters to be discussed at a meeting.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常被誤認為是「隱藏的動機」，但在正式場合中通常指會議討論的清單。文中：While AI is expected to be on the agenda, many experts are not optimistic about a major breakthrough.

quiz.question: According to the article, what is one specific action Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei has proposed regarding AI development?

options.A: He wants to immediately stop all AI research in China.
options.B: He suggests a global plan to slow down the creation of the most advanced AI models.
options.C: He believes that the US should remove all export restrictions on computer chips.
options.D: He thinks that AI development should be left entirely to private companies without government interference.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，Anthropic 的執行長 Dario Amodei 提議制定一項全球計畫，以減緩最先進 AI 模型的研發速度。選項 A 錯誤，因為他主張的是與中國合作而非完全停止研究；選項 C 與原文相反，他實際上支持限制晶片出口；選項 D 與他主張的嚴格規則相悖。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the motivation behind Jensen Huang’s skepticism toward AI regulation?

options.A: He is primarily concerned with the ethical implications of AI safety.
options.B: He believes that existing scientific evidence proves AI is a global threat.
options.C: His business interests may influence his desire to avoid industry delays.
options.D: He is working closely with the Chinese government to develop new safety laws.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第三段，分析師指出 Huang 的立場可能與其公司的財務成功有關，因為任何產業延遲都可能損害他的業務成長。選項 A 錯誤，因為他認為 AI 威脅被誇大了；選項 B 錯誤，他明確表示擔憂缺乏科學依據；選項 D 在文中並無提及，且他反對新法規。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the term 'fearmongering' most likely mean as used by the Chinese foreign ministry?

options.A: The act of spreading exaggerated warnings to cause unnecessary public alarm.
options.B: A strategic plan to improve national cybersecurity standards.
options.C: The process of negotiating peaceful agreements between rival nations.
options.D: A scientific method used to test the safety limits of new AI models.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。Fearmongering（散布恐懼）在文中是指中國外交部批評西方國家對 AI 風險的誇大警告，目的是以此作為競爭手段。選項 B 錯誤，因為這與安全標準無關；選項 C 錯誤，這是一個負面詞彙，與和平談判相反；選項 D 錯誤，這並非科學測試方法。

quiz.question: What is the central theme of this article regarding the global AI landscape?

options.A: The technological race is primarily focused on improving education systems in China.
options.B: There is a universal consensus among world leaders that AI must be strictly regulated.
options.C: The rapid advancement of AI has created a complex conflict involving safety concerns, national rivalry, and economic interests.
options.D: The meeting between President Trump and President Xi Jinping is guaranteed to resolve all global AI tensions.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文綜述了全球對 AI 的不同態度，包含技術領袖的爭論、地緣政治競爭（美中對抗）、經濟考量以及監管困難，這正是文章的核心主旨。選項 A 僅是文末提到的個別案例；選項 B 錯誤，因為文中強調各方意見分歧；選項 D 錯誤，專家對該會議的成果並不樂觀。
